cards.card_text: Zophar tells Job what he's heard him say: that his doctrine is sound, and that he is ___ in God's sight.
cards.verse_text: You have said, ‘My doctrine is sound, and I am pure in Your sight.’
cards.snippet: You have said, ‘My doctrine is sound, and I am pure in Your sight.’

cards.card_text: In the words from Isaiah that Jesus quotes, these people teach the rules of ___ as doctrine.
cards.verse_text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’”
cards.snippet: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’”
